svg.text: MULTI-OMICS · PATHWAY & FLUX MODELLING · TARGET RANKING · REPRODUCIBLE ANALYSIS
DATA SOURCES · DIFFERENT INSTRUMENTS, DIFFERENT UNITS, DIFFERENT ERROR STRUCTURES
batch effect is the default state
n is almost always smaller than p
record the method, not just the matrix
conflating the two inflates every p
consent and scope bound the use
selection bias travels with the cohort
a prior is evidence with a weight
an unreplicated result is a hypothesis
QC · NORMALISE · BATCH-CORRECT · HARMONISE UNITS · RECORD EVERY CHOICE
an uncorrected p-value on 20 000 features is not a finding
a node is only a target if inhibiting it moves the phenotype — not merely because it correlates
flux balance and isotope tracing disagree often enough that both are worth running
error bars are biological replicates, not technical ones
a curve without a plateau is an extrapolation wearing a fit
DEVELOPMENT LADDER · EACH GATE HAS AN EXIT CRITERION AND A REALISTIC ATTRITION RATE
Attrition is the honest headline: the great majority of programmes that clear target ID never reach a candidate molecule —
so the value of the work sits in killing the wrong hypothesis cheaply and early, not in defending it late.
REPRODUCIBILITY LAYER · THE PART THAT DECIDES WHETHER ANY OF THE ABOVE SURVIVES REVIEW

g.text: a figure names the exact input it used
rerun in two years, same numbers
endpoints and tests fixed before the look
exploratory results are labelled as such
the failed arm is stored beside the successful one
a pipeline that only retains wins manufactures them
